# Vocabulary: source_kind

Type of cited source.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `paper` | Peer-reviewed paper | Journal or conference publication. |
| `preprint` | Preprint | arXiv or similar, not yet peer-reviewed. |
| `tech-report` | Technical report / blog | Lab or company technical write-up. |
| `news` | News | Journalism or trade press. |
| `docs` | Documentation | Official product, engine, or wiki documentation. |
| `store-page` | Store page | Steam, console, or app store listing. |
| `talk` | Talk / video | GDC talk, conference video, or recorded presentation. |
| `postmortem` | Postmortem / interview | Developer account of how a game was made. |
| `book` | Book | Published book or chapter. |
| `encyclopedia` | Encyclopedia / wiki | Wikipedia or a community wiki. |
| `repository` | Code repository / dataset | Source code or dataset release. |
